description: Human-review queue for PNG legal material discovery and document verification. Queue entries are leads, not verified legal instruments.

candidates.title: PNG Constitution online text — edition and amendment verification
candidates.discovery_method: official institutional website review
candidates.source_name: Ombudsman Commission of Papua New Guinea
candidates.reviewer_notes: Confirm edition, amendment coverage, certification/publication trail and later constitutional alterations against authoritative Gazette and parliamentary records. Page availability alone does not establish verification or current force.

candidates.title: Office of Legislative Counsel — source authority and publication pathway review
candidates.discovery_method: official government website review
candidates.reviewer_notes: PMNEC describes OLC functions involving legislative advice, vetting, amendments, editing and printing. Confirm whether OLC provides a public document repository or formal verification contact. This is a source lead, not a legal instrument.

candidates.title: CLRC — reports and recommendations discovery
candidates.discovery_method: official commission website review
candidates.source_name: Constitutional and Law Reform Commission of Papua New Guinea
candidates.reviewer_notes: Separate final reports, draft bills, constitutional directives and recommendations. A recommendation is not enacted law unless enactment and commencement are independently established.

candidates.title: National Gazette archive — coverage, provenance and reuse review
candidates.discovery_method: legal information archive discovery
candidates.reviewer_notes: For each instrument capture Gazette issue number, date and page, then compare with an official or certified copy. Confirm archive completeness, scan integrity and redistribution terms.

candidates.title: Organic Law on Provincial Governments and Local-level Governments — principal Organic Law No. 16 of 1995
candidates.discovery_method: official Ombudsman Commission legislation page and DPLGA official copy
candidates.reviewer_notes: IDENTITY: PacLII index updated 14 April 2022 identifies principal Organic Law as No.16/1995, commenced 19 July 1995 (Bougainville 1 Jan 1999; NCD commencement originally gazetted 21 Oct 2021 under G712/2021). It separately identifies No.29/1998 as Amendment No.7. Ombudsman Commission webpage labels hosted text 'No.29 of 1998', likely conflating principal instrument and amendment number. IMPORTANT NCD UPDATE: G215/2023 corrigendum purported to defer NCD commencement until later of corrigendum publication or repeal of NCDC Act 2001. A National Court interlocutory ruling in Hanenamo Development Ltd v NCDC & Independent State of PNG, N11736 (24 Feb 2026), is reported as holding the corrigendum void ab initio because not authorised by the Organic Law or Interpretation Act. This strongly supports original G712 notice not being displaced, but obtain official judgment, confirm procedural/finality/appeal status before setting legal status. Keep status_unknown until legal review.

candidates.title: Provincial Governments Administration Act 1997 — No. 7 of 1997
candidates.discovery_method: DPLGA official-copy PDF and FAOLEX metadata cross-check
candidates.source_name: Department of Provincial and Local Government Affairs
candidates.reviewer_notes: IDENTITY CONFIRMED: DPLGA-hosted document identifies Provincial Governments Administration Act 1997, No. 7 of 1997, and states it implements aspects of the Organic Law. NEFC also lists a copy. Exact amendment history, any commencement notices, current consolidation date and repeal/savings status have not been fully checked. Treat DPLGA file as an official-copy source, not proof this is the latest consolidated text. Keep legal_status status_unknown.

candidates.title: Local-level Governments Administration Act 1997 — No. 33 of 1997
candidates.discovery_method: DPLGA official-copy PDF, NEFC listing and FAOLEX/vLex amendment leads
candidates.source_name: Department of Provincial and Local Government Affairs
candidates.reviewer_notes: IDENTITY CONFIRMED: DPLGA-hosted official-copy PDF identifies Local-level Governments Administration Act 1997, No. 33 of 1997. NEFC also lists it. FAOLEX metadata reports a 2005 text/revision; vLex identifies a 2014 amendment Act No. 47 and notes it had not commenced as at that database edition, while also referring to a consolidation to No. 13 of 2022. These secondary statements require primary Gazette/commencement confirmation. No current consolidated primary text established. Keep legal_status status_unknown.

candidates.title: District Development Authority Act 2014 — No. 40 of 2014
candidates.discovery_method: DPLGA official-copy PDF and secondary amendment-history cross-check
candidates.source_name: Department of Provincial and Local Government Affairs
candidates.reviewer_notes: IDENTITY CONFIRMED: DPLGA-hosted official-copy PDF identifies District Development Authority Act 2014, No. 40 of 2014. PacLII's PNG legislation index updated 14 April 2022 lists commencement 1 January 2015. The same index marks the 2015 No.37 and 2016 No.11 amendment Acts N.I.F. (not in force) as at that index date. It lists the 2021 No.14 amendment as commencing 1 January 2022, with Gazette G80/2022. This resolves the older vLex warning for the 2021 amendment: that warning is stale. Still check for post-2022 amendments and obtain a dated official consolidated text before declaring the principal Act current as at 2026. Keep the principal Act legal_status status_unknown.

candidates.title: District Development Authority (Amendment) Act 2021 — No. 14 of 2021
candidates.discovery_method: legislation amendment cross-reference
candidates.legal_status_evidence: National Gazette No. G80, published 4 February 2022, gives a Notice of Commencement fixing 1 January 2022 for No.14 of 2021 — District Development Authority (Amendment) Act 2021. The Gazette is published by authority. The PacLII PNG legislation index updated 14 April 2022 independently lists commencement 1 January 2022 and cites G80/2022.
candidates.reviewer_notes: The earlier 2021 DDA amendment Act (No.14 of 2021) commenced 1 January 2022 under G80/2022. This entry remains a separate amendment candidate; it is not evidence of later amendments after 2021.

candidates.title: National Gazette No. G712 — NCD commencement notice for Organic Law on Provincial Governments and Local-level Governments 1995 No.16 of 1995

A later corrigendum in G215/2023 attempted to defer commencement; National Court interlocutory ruling N11736 (Hanenamo Development Ltd v NCDC & Independent State of PNG, 24 Feb 2026) is reported as holding the corrigendum void ab initio. Obtain certified judgment and verify appeal/finality. Do not treat the corrigendum as effective without considering this ruling.

candidates.title: CLRC Terms of Reference No. 26 — Review of Laws Relating to District Development Authorities
candidates.discovery_method: CLRC official news release
candidates.reviewer_notes: CLRC announced on 13 August 2026 that it launched the Issues Paper for TOR No.26, a nationwide review of DDA laws. CLRC states TOR 26 was endorsed and gazetted by the Minister early in 2026 and that the review will examine current DDA enabling laws and recommend reforms. This is a law-reform process, not enacted amendment. Obtain gazetted TOR and Issues Paper, track consultation and final report; do not infer legal changes from recommendations.

candidates.title: Hanenamo Development Limited v National Capital District Commission and Independent State of PNG — N11736 (24 February 2026)
candidates.discovery_method: 2026 National Court decision surfaced in legal database search
candidates.source_name: vLex Papua New Guinea legal database
candidates.reviewer_notes: Secondary database report identifies National Court interlocutory ruling N11736, judgment dated 24 February 2026 (hearing/facts 4 December 2025), on whether G215/2023 corrigendum could alter G712/2021 Organic Law commencement in NCD. Reported holding: fixing date is delegated law-making under the Organic Law; corrigendum void ab initio because not authorised by Organic Law or Interpretation Act ss89–90. Obtain official signed judgment from National Court registry/PacLII; verify exact orders, whether appeal/review filed or decided, and precedential scope before relying on it as definitive. This is court evidence, not an amendment to the Organic Law.

usage_notes: Discovery does not establish authenticity, legal effect, current legal status, or redistribution rights.
Review source identity and each resource before approval.
Verify legal status using appropriate evidence before recording a resource as in force.
Check redistribution permission before storing or distributing copies.
When permission is unknown, retain permitted metadata and source links instead of assuming copying is allowed.
Do not add personal, confidential, or completed case documents.
Keep rejected and duplicate records distinguishable from approved records.
Only approved candidates may be transferred to the legal-resources catalogue.
A source-authority review candidate is not itself legislation.
Amendment database statements about commencement are time-bounded secondary evidence. Confirm current legal effect from the original Act and Gazette commencement notice.

When recording commencement, capture the Gazette issue, publication date, page, named instrument and the actual commencement date separately; the Gazette publication date and commencement date may differ.

Organic Law number reconciliation: principal Organic Law is indexed as No.16/1995; No.29/1998 is separately indexed as Amendment No.7 Law. Do not assign No.29/1998 to the principal Organic Law without certified source evidence.

Do not evaluate Gazette G215/2023 corrigendum in isolation: record National Court ruling N11736 (24 February 2026) reportedly holding it void ab initio, and verify official judgment and appeal status.
